div.p: I'm Prashant Sharma, an AI automation engineer, full-stack developer and open-source maintainer from India. I build open-source SDKs and APIs with Next.js and TypeScript at Xtream Ventures, and I care a lot about technical SEO and developer experience.

Right now I'm shipping FMUI, a React component library for Next.js built on Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, and World Kit, a TypeScript toolkit for countries, currencies and timezones. I also maintain DamAPI for lake and dam water levels, with government data SDKs for NOAA, NASA, USGS, FEMA and the Census Bureau in progress.
Goals for 2026: publish 25+ npm packages, cross 1M npm downloads and ship 10+ production APIs.
